name: dataset34v5
description: dataset34v4 with every claim and every reference experiment rewritten by Claude Opus 5 against the whole paper, appendices included. Same 34 claims and the same 14 shared subfield cards.
notes: Rewritten to move the references and claims off the distribution of the GPT models being evaluated: v3/v4 text was drafted by gpt-5.6-sol, which is also a proposer.
The rewrite was done against the FULL paper. v3 extracted only the first 18 pages, so some papers were drafted from as little as 46% of their text; see fulltext.FULL_PAPER.
Three split corrections were applied during the rewrite; rewrite_notes.json records each with its reason.
Experiment texts now state, where it applies, which clause of the claim's bar a result does or does not meet, and flag figure-only or unnumbered results as such.
Roles in new claims' references: own experiments = headline (control/confound kept), shared setup = apparatus.
References are model-drafted and NOT human-reviewed; provenance says so and the judge is shown that line.
Cards are per-SUBFIELD: retrieved with queries built from the field name and taxonomy keywords only, never claim text, then served unchanged to every claim in that field.
subfields.json carries 10 hand corrections to the classifier; subfield_overrides.json records each with its rationale, and subfields_original is kept beside each.
